svg.title: An idle evening: the backlight, from the last key press to a dark panel
svg.desc: A step chart of the panel's backlight, out of 100, against time since the last key press (not to scale). Another app runs at your own level. Home brings the painting to the front and the backlight eases to 35. After 30 minutes without a key, or 2 minutes between 23:00 and 07:00, a veil comes down over 2.6 seconds, the widgets and the dock go, one dim clock stays and the backlight drops to 1. The clock steps to a new spot every 4 minutes along a path 44 pixels wide and 28 tall. Between midnight and 07:00, after 3 hours idle with nothing playing, the panel goes dark. Any key wakes it in 1.1 seconds and does nothing else. Timings are from the page's code.
svg.text: An idle evening: the backlight, from the last key press to a dark panel
The painting comes to the front,
A veil comes down over 2.6 s.
Only a dim clock stays, and it
steps to a new spot every 4 min.
